_comment: CANONICAL PRIMARY NAV — the single source of truth for the site chrome. Consumed by React (components/SiteNav.tsx, components/seo/PublicPageShell.tsx) and mirrored into public/assets/starta-nav.js, which renders it on every static HTML page. The mirror is build-gated: scripts/verify-route-aliases.mjs fails if the two drift. Add or reorder items HERE ONLY. `cta` is null: the profile CTA is a normal nav item (nav_risk), not a button. nav_pulse (/Market-Pulse) was restored to the bar on 2026-09-06 by owner request — the page has always shipped in both languages (app/Market-Pulse + app/ar/Market-Pulse); only the menu entry was missing.
